description:
North star: compile work proportional to input. "What does this reach" is answered once per node and shared, never re-walked per asker.

Two implementations answer the same question today (fz-xxd.10, 4a412b66a):
- Static arm. Recursive(f) = f reaches itself over StaticCallees. derive_recursive (jobs/keying.rs, collect_static_graph + strong_component) walks f's whole reachable static graph per function. StaticCallees(g) is demanded only when a walk reaches g, so a walk blocks once per level, and concurrent walkers over one region each pay it: W callers into a chain of depth D cost W*D runs that change nothing. Develop hid this because main/0 walked first and warmed the region; fz-xxd.10's self-keyed rows (R1) removed that walker.
- Executable arms. Transport on-cycle = executable_reaches (jobs/transport.rs:2117, called from cut_in_component_returns at :2207 Direct and :2244 All): a depth-first search over settled ExecutableFacts, once per edge per product evaluation, with a settled read per visited node. Measured on develop 075f5e0a8: json_roundtrip 1,767 searches, 62,502 visits, over 207 distinct starting nodes; 00420 1,281 searches, 10,939 visits, 178 starting nodes. Edges never leave the owner's root (semantic.rs:2243, callable_target.rs:66), so the executable arms are root-scoped; the static arm is program-scoped (fz-xxd.14).

Design: one product ProductKey::Reach { from, arm }, value = the set reached from `from`; arms Static (FunctionId over StaticCallees) and Direct / All (ExecutableKey over ExecutableFacts call targets, the edge choice executable_reaches makes today). Computed from `from`'s edges plus the nested Reach products of its successors; mutually dependent Reach products settle as one recursive group (pull.rs pending_strong_component). Recursive(f) = f in Reach{f, Static}; on-cycle = owner in the matching Reach. Deleted: collect_static_graph, strong_component, executable_reaches and its per-visit reads.

Evidence: spike B (scratch reach/B/spike.patch, Static arm only) deleted the static walk and met the static acceptance below in every source order; it needs fz-xxd.14 (it had to borrow a root). Spike A (fact layer, reach/A) is order-dependent by construction: without group settlement the only deadlock-free gate rule is an id order, so callers-first source keeps the walk. Paper: scratch reach/paper.md.

Acceptance (fixtures added and pinned by fz-xxd.10 in DERIVE_RECURSIVE_RATCHET; W=4 callers, chain depth 8; values are DeriveRecursive runs / runs that change nothing as counted by `fz2 run --log-telemetry`):
- 00607 shared chain, callees first: 44/32 -> 16/4
- 00608 shared chain, callers first: 44/32 -> 16/4
- 00609 shared chain into a mutual recursion, callees first: 62/48 -> 18/4
- 00610 the same, callers first: 62/48 -> 18/4
- runs that change nothing do not depend on chain depth or source order; Recursive answers unchanged (chain false, the recursion pair true);
- executable arm: json_roundtrip <= 207 Reach evaluations at settlement with one ExecutableFacts read per node (was 1,767 searches / 62,502 visits); 00420 <= 194 (156 Direct + 38 All); json no slower than develop; the full timing sum <= develop;
- census outputs identical against develop 075f5e0a8; no pin rises.
- a test where a function's StaticCallees grows later (a lambda target or provider boundary) and closes a new cycle: the Reach products it touches re-open and Recursive turns true (fz-afu.8 showed a walk that stops at an already-known answer is unsound here);
- static reads proportional to edges, not edges x functions, on 00420_enum_take_drop_split, pinned.

Folds fz-afu.8 (the same per-function walk, filed against the old DeriveCallGraphComponent).
title: One reach authority: each node's reach is computed once and shared
